name: flame.a2a/agents.v1
description: List configured remote agents without contacting them.

name: flame.a2a/cancel.v1
description: Request cancellation of the remote task bound to the original requestId. Only the returned remote state confirms cancellation; local interruption or transport failure does not. An unconfirmed cancel must never be resubmitted.

name: flame.a2a/send.v1
description: Send one message up to 64 KiB to a configured remote agent. Return the remote task or message and the original requestId. A response is bounded to 2 MiB. Preserve the command identity: an unconfirmed send must never be resubmitted.

name: flame.a2a/status.v1
description: Read the remote task bound to the original requestId, using its captured endpoint and task identity. This does not replay a send or advance local task state.
